primary_interest.quote: We want a voice AI support agent that picks up inbound calls from customers, handles the first line of questions, and hands off to a human when it needs to.

use_case.quote: We want a voice AI support agent that picks up inbound calls from customers, handles the first line of questions, and hands off to a human when it needs to.

edge_framing.quote: It's its own product, you could buy it by itself through the API and it doesn't need our voice agents at all.

edge_raised_by.quote: We also have Edge Compute, where you run functions close to your users.

competitors_edge.quote: Right now we're looking at Cloudflare Workers, and we also use AWS Lambda for some of it.

decision_criteria.quote: First, cost predictability. I don't want a surprise bill because call volume spiked or some usage line I didn't understand showed up. Second, integration effort, how quickly can my team get this live, because I have maybe two engineers on it. Third, latency.

stated_reason.quote: If the agent pauses too long, people talk over it and the whole thing falls apart.
